hero.title: Backend Developer (Go / Node.js)
hero.tagline: Go · Node.js · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · Redis · Docker · Microservices · Clean Architecture
hero.bio: Backend developer with 3+ years building production APIs and distributed systems. Specialized in Go and Node.js/TypeScript with measurable results: reduced API response times by 50%+, eliminated duplicate processing across high-throughput systems serving 50K+ daily operations, and architected multi-tenant platforms for 10+ organizations. Passionate about idempotency, observability, and clean architecture that scales.

item1.description: Remote web developer for orthodontic clinic in Auckland, New Zealand.
achievements: Redesigned clinic web presence improving page load speed by 40% and mobile usability scores from 65 to 92
Delivered 15+ web updates in a 6-week sprint across NZ/CL time zones with zero critical bugs

item2.description: Designed and implemented the API core and content management system.
achievements: Architected REST API core reducing initial response time by 50% via optimized middleware
Implemented JWT RBAC with 6 permission levels across 3 user roles and 20+ endpoints
Integrated Cloudinary CDN cutting media load times by 70%
Built CI/CD pipeline reducing deployment time from 30 min to 8 min

item3.description: Supported the maintenance of web platforms and integration of marketing tools.
achievements: Maintained 5+ client websites concurrently with 99.9% uptime
Integrated 3 marketing APIs (Mailchimp, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel) automating cross-platform sync
Built webhook automation saving 10+ hours/month in manual reporting

item4.description: Specialized in critical integrations and backend performance optimization.
achievements: Implemented WooCommerce sync engine handling 50K+ daily ops with idempotency guarantees — zero duplicates in 3 months
Reduced incident response time from 4h to 30min via monitoring
Optimized 10+ SQL queries reducing avg execution from 2.3s to 180ms

item1.title: GoPotency — Idempotency in Go
item1.description: Open-source Go middleware guaranteeing idempotency for HTTP endpoints. Supports body-hash and header-based key strategies with PostgreSQL or Redis backends. Designed for zero-duplicate guarantees in payment, webhook, and event-processing systems.

item2.title: QuickAttendance — Go Migration
item2.description: Full migration of Node.js attendance system to Go using Clean Architecture. Multi-tenant support for 10+ orgs, async processing with RabbitMQ, real-time monitoring via Prometheus/Grafana.

item3.title: AutoAttendance — Microservices
item3.description: End-to-end attendance management with QR check-in and geofencing. Microservices architecture handling 100+ concurrent users with sub-200ms API response times.

topgg.title: Bot Status Notice
paragraphs: Mankekito is currently undergoing a major update. While the original code is deprecated and the bot is temporarily offline, you can still view its profile on Top.gg, a professional Discord bot listing platform.

The bot achieved official verification status and served over 10,000 users across more than 260 servers during its active period. A new version with improved features and modern architecture is in development.
